records.text: Don Frye trained in judo at Fort Huachuca after graduating from high school in Sierra Vista.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: but he actually graduated from high school in Sierra Vista and then trained in judo at Fort Huachuca.

verification.notes: Biographical material supports Don Frye's Sierra Vista/Buena High connection and his later judo training. His own long-form account does not establish that he began judo at Fort Huachuca, so the location-specific part remains unsupported.

sources.title: The Joe Rogan Experience #1668 - Don Frye transcript
sources.relevance: Frye's first-person biographical account provides the strongest accessible evidence about when and how he began judo.
